tasks.spec: You are a trivial placeholder worker for a billed opening probe that Ringer's check performs itself. Boundary: do NOT run any probe, do NOT call any model or network service, do NOT touch any file except the one you own, never git commit. Your only job: write the single line 'ready control' into the file /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/richer-3a-probe/frame/control-open-ready.txt (create it; the directory exists). Nothing else is needed; the check afterwards runs the opening probe for the control arm twelve times (Amendment 16 of .plans/richer-3a-probe-prereg.md) and writes control-open.json next to it. Do not read or edit anything else.
tasks.check:
set -o pipefail
cd /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge
export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge:/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/packages/worldkeeper/src
[ ! -e /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/richer-3a-probe/frame/control-open.json ] || { echo 'rows file already exists; refusing to re-bill'; exit 1; }
/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/scripts/ringer/3a-open-issues/opening_arms.py bench/variations/richer-3a-frame-control.json 12 /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/richer-3a-probe/frame/control-open.json 2>&1 | tee /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/richer-3a-probe/frame/control-open.log
/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json,sys
r=json.load(open('/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/richer-3a-probe/frame/control-open.json'))
errs=[x['i'] for x in r if x.get('error')]
print('rows',len(r),'errors',len(errs))
want='Michelle was among them.' in r[0]['prompt']['user']
gone='Michelle is beside the captives.' not in r[0]['prompt']['user']
print('prompt has new sentence:',want,'old sentence gone:',gone)
ok = len(r)==12 and (want and gone if 'control'=='candidate' else (not want and not gone))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 'rows or prompts not as intended')
PY
tasks.verified: the opening probe exited 0, wrote 12 rows, and the prompts carry the intended frame wording
